newton_calibration.status: prepared as a contribution on top of the base revision; not merged at the time of writing

hardware.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 96 GB

li2013.citation: Li, Zhang & Goldman (2013), Science 339:1408, doi:10.1126/science.1229163, additional data table S5

zwanenburg2023.citation: Zwanenburg et al. (2023), Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.8066899, CC BY 4.0; article Zwanenburg et al. (2024), doi:10.1061/JGGEFK.GTENG-12104
zwanenburg2023.redistributed: processed net-pressure curves of tests 1, 3, 6 and 8 in data/clay_laboratory.json

derived_files.rft_points.json: simulated alpha_z, alpha_x for 78 (beta, gamma) points, literature and calibrated parameters; measured values omitted
derived_files.rft_calibration.json: calibration summary of the plate-intrusion run; measured reference arrays removed
derived_files.rft_search.json: parameters and objectives of every simulated candidate of the plate-intrusion run
derived_files.clay_laboratory.json: scored clay pressures, measured curves (CC BY 4.0, processed) and the every-10th-step simulated history
derived_files.rake_result.json: rake calibration summary including the hidden parameters of the synthetic logs
derived_files.rake_traces.json: synthetic logged, baseline and calibrated rake forces per stroke
derived_files.rake_search.json: parameters and objectives of every simulated candidate of the rake run
derived_files.source_hashes.json: SHA-256 of the archived sources the files above were derived from
derived_files.clay_force_series_test1.json: simulated test-1 plate pressure at every step for the first 22 mm, with window means and medians
derived_files.rft_force_series.json: simulated vertical plate force at every step for beta 0, gamma 90 deg, with its voxel-phase profile
derived_files.clay_laboratory_1ms.json: clay predictions with the laboratory strength at the rejected 1 ms step
derived_files.rejected_runs.json: records of the rejected 2 ms plate-intrusion calibration, the rejected 1 ms clay calibration and the stopped 0.5 ms clay calibration

scripts.scripts/export_data.py: derives data/ from the newton-calibration archive and run directories
scripts.scripts/make_figures.py: draws figures/ from data/ and the processed Li et al. table
scripts.scripts/probe_force_time_series.py: runs the two per-step force probes and writes data/clay_dips_test1.json and data/rft_dips_probe.json

notes: Run times were measured while other runs shared the GPU.
The plate-intrusion training set and bounds were chosen after the literature sweep and the rejected 2 ms calibration.
Clay tests 1 and 3 used the first clay batch, tests 6 and 8 the second; laboratory SHANSEP parameters come from the first batch.
